stem.id: Dina punya 12 kelereng. Ia memberi 4 kelereng kepada Budi. Berapa kelereng Dina sekarang?
stem.en: Dina has 12 marbles. She gives 4 marbles to Budi. How many marbles does Dina have now?

stem.id: Di dalam bus ada 9 penumpang. Di halte pertama 5 orang naik. Di halte kedua 3 orang turun. Berapa penumpang di bus sekarang?
stem.en: A bus has 9 passengers. At the first stop 5 people get on. At the second stop 3 people get off. How many passengers are on the bus now?

explanation.id: Naik berarti tambah: 9 + 5 = 14. Turun berarti kurang: 14 - 3 = 11.
explanation.en: Getting on means add: 9 + 5 = 14. Getting off means subtract: 14 - 3 = 11.
